_: Which provider holds the registered copy of each official template, and under which id. Committed on purpose: the id has to travel INSIDE the package, or two machines disagree about which directory row is which template (operator 2026-09-05: npm 自带的需要跟 cloud 的 official 对齐). This is a REGISTRATION record, not a fetch record — these templates were published from here, not downloaded — so it does not reuse the `<name>.yaml.source.json` provenance sidecar, whose `source_network`/`fetched_at` would both be saying something untrue. `spec_sha256` is the bytes that were registered; a test compares it against the packaged file, so editing an official template without re-registering goes red instead of drifting quietly. `version` is `metadata.version` as it stood when those bytes were registered: the provider refuses a re-registration whose bytes changed without it advancing (409 VERSION_NOT_ADVANCED), so the two travel together by construction, and a test compares this against the packaged file the same way it compares the digest.
